AI Overview
Play Planet Clicker directly in your web browser or on mobile through platforms like Coolmath Games and CrazyGames. 
Core Gameplay & Objective
Objective: Click planets to generate energy, buy automated production upgrades, and unlock new worlds across the solar system. 
Starting Planet (Earth): Begin by tapping Earth to earn initial energy, then purchase early upgrades like click multipliers, animal farms, and power plants.

Expansion: Switch between planets using the navigation arrows at the bottom of the screen.
Mars: Unlocked with accumulated energy, featuring coal, solar oil, nuclear power, and alien technology.
Venus: Unlocked for 1 trillion energy units, featuring iron, lava, and future technology upgrades.

Strategy & Tips
Balance Active vs. Idle: Tap rapidly in the early game, then transition to passive auto-generators (such as atoms, molecules, and alien tech) that earn energy per second.
Early Upgrades: Focus on cheap, frequent upgrades rather than saving up for massive, distant purchases right away.
Sequel: Check out Planet Clicker 2 for more planets, updated Unity graphics, and expanded industrial tech.
